title: Critique: the P3b may index post-perceptual processing

statements.text: When stimuli are task-irrelevant yet reported seen, only the earlier N2 negativity remains and the P3b disappears, so the P3b may index post-perceptual processing rather than awareness. The GNW authors call the question unresolved.

sources.locator: Empirical Evidence in Support of the Ignition Concept, p. 779
sources.quote: It remains unclear whether P3b is correlated with awareness (Salti et al., 2012), post-perceptual processes (Andersen et al., 2016; Koivisto et al., 2016), or both.
